title: Level 5 — Dispatch Hermes + iQuest + save to team sandbox

stages.prompt: Use wren_dispatch_hermes with task='In ONE sentence: what is a good default keep-alive strategy for a 15-node council of local Ollama models sharing a single GPU?'. STAGE_OUT: Hermes's reply first 200 chars.
Use wren_dispatch_iquest with task='In 4 lines of Python: a function called warm_hi(name) that returns a greeting including today date in ISO format'. STAGE_OUT: iQuest's code first 300 chars.

Use wren_write_file with path='data/team_sandbox/L5_wren_hermes_iquest.md' and content='# L5 team result

## Hermes said
<paste from prior stage 1>

## iQuest said
```python
<paste from prior stage 2>
```
'. STAGE_OUT: tool result.

Use wren_bash cmd='wc -l data/team_sandbox/L5_wren_hermes_iquest.md && cat data/team_sandbox/L5_wren_hermes_iquest.md'. STAGE_OUT: the file content, then a final line: 'L5 VERDICT: team_playing=<yes|no>, sandbox_saved=<yes|no>'.
